entity.description:
10x Kamehameha Ball is a technique used by Rage Shenron.

Rage uses his elasticity to catch a 10x Kamehameha, mold it into a ball, and fire it back at his opponent. Rage can also use it on other techniques as well.

Rage used this technique against Goku and Pan.
